.arch armv8-a
        .file   "add.c"
        .text
        .align  2
        .global add
        .type   add, %function
add:
.LFB0:
        .cfi_startproc
        add     w0, w0, w1
        ret
        .cfi_endproc
.LFE0:
        .size   add, .-add
        .ident  "GCC: (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04) 13.3.0"
        .section        .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
